BiblicalUsage: The sense of rôwmâm is exaltation, that is (figuratively and specifically) praise. It stands in Psalms 66:17: "…mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that rôwmâm counts, because God put it in his book.
